headline: NXP-affiliated Accellera chair reports SystemC-AMS revision and regression-test progress
fact: Martin Barnasconi, identified with NXP and as Accellera SystemC Technical Committee chair, presented the SystemC-AMS standardization status at SystemC Evolution Fika. The slides report preparation for the next IEEE 1666.1 revision and work toward a public regression-test repository. Accellera coordinates this standardization work; it is not an NXP product release. The presentation does not announce a newly issued standard or the first public regression suite: a 2023 presentation already links a regression-test tar archive.

sources.title: SystemC-AMS standardization status: April 2026
sources.summary: The status slides identify Barnasconi (NXP), next-revision preparation and ongoing work to make the regression suite available through a public repository.

sources.title: SystemC Evolution Fika: April 23, 2026
sources.summary: The official program dates the standards-status presentation and identifies Barnasconi and his Accellera chair role.

sources.title: SystemC-AMS standardization update: November 2023
sources.summary: The earlier presentation already lists a released regression suite with more than 700 tests and a public tar download; the 2026 work is not its first public availability.
